journal_lines: Witch in the clearing. Moved fast.
Cackle in the dark. Found it before it found me.
Hut on stilts no one had visited in years. Smoke rising anyway.
She knew I was there. I knew she knew. We were polite about it for as long as we could be.
Bottles on a string in the branches. Each one full of something.
Threw a green one. The grass yellowed where it landed.
Drank her own potion before the fight. So did I, in my own way.
Laughed once. The laugh was older than the witch.
Sugar-and-spider smell on the air. Followed it backward.
Found her cauldron after. Still warm. Did not drink.
